content: Root cause: The bug was caused by unnecessary checks for RCU (Read-Copy-Update) deferred wakeup during user or guest entry, which were only relevant when the nohz_full feature was running on the local CPU. This led to performance regressions in fast-paths, as the system was needlessly processing RCU wakeup checks, impacting overall performance by approximately 3%. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the RCU deferred wakeup check is only performed when it is actually needed, thus optimizing the entry paths and improving performance.
